current.summary: New en-suite shower room off the bedroom, mostly built but not finished. Walk-in shower at the end: deep-blue glazed tiles laid vertically, large grey stone-effect tiles on the side, a tiled niche, black rain-shower head, a raised tiled shower floor with a square drain. No glass screen — a curtain on a tension rod for now. Close-coupled WC against a half-height band of the blue tiles. In the corner, a vanity made of two oak shelves with a round white countertop basin; the black tap is not yet fitted, a mirror is propped behind, and bare wires hang from the wall above for a light. Half-height blue tiling runs round the room with white walls above; a blue-tiled sill at the window, whose shutters are patched with filler. A high plastered ledge holds baskets, with an old beam exposed in the recess above. Recessed downlights and colour-changing LED lighting. Floor: light-grey tiles.
keep: Blue vertical tiles and grey tiles
